chapter: Leaving home: Fisk, Tulsa, Arkansas City
title: Lee Deere's $14 offer and leaving his aunt's house
summary: Deere offered him $14 a week to play piano in Arkansas City, Kansas, and he left in a car before his strict aunt could phone his parents.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And so Lee Deere told me, he says, 'Look, I can take you up to play piano for some friends of mine, but Art Bronson is playing at my club, but see, I'd like to have you with these guys here. But Art's playing at my club. But if you go,' he says, 'I'll guarantee you $14 a week and you'll make good tips.' I said, 'Oh,' I didn't believe it, you know. He says, 'Yes, I'll guarantee it, yes.' So then I got to thinking. I said, Well, I think I'll take this,' you know?
Well, listen, Jay, I'm a little muddled. Art Bronson was playing with the group he came to take?

Well, Art had maybe three or four guys up there he had been using. But, see, they wanted this band those musicians, like the saxophone player, the trumpet player, the drummer, and the girl that -- well, they didn't want the girl that played piano, but all the rest of the band and the other -- you know, like you come into a club and take a whole band out of what you want?
So that's what they were really doing, you know?
And so they were asking you to come on piano?
No, the boys knew me. Hunter Gray,

the Gray brothers, and they knew that he was also looking for a piano player for his friends. So they called me and says, "How about making this? We going," which was in Arkansas City, Kansas. So I was staying with my uncle and aunt in Tulsa, and she was just as strict as my parents, more strict, you know.
Was this uncle your mother's brother or your father's brother?

My father's brother. And so she came up, she says, "Who are those people?" I says, "They are from up in Kansas." She says, "What did they want?" I says, "They offered me a job." She says, "Well, what did you tell them?" I said, "I told them I'd leave with them." She said, "You're not leaving." I said, "Oh, yeah. I'm leaving."
